units.title: 文书消息：以文书为主、官鬼为凭；官印文书宜父动，民修票约忌财兴，财临身世徒书契，用不空亡准此情；凡论文书票约取父母为用爻，旺则有成空则无用，财爻为动或值世身空劳纸笔枉费神思

rule.yi: 论文书、消息，以文书爻为主，以官鬼为凭据。官府的印信文书，适宜父爻发动；民间立的票据契约，忌讳财爻兴旺；财爻临在身爻、世爻上，书契就白写；用爻不落空亡，就按这个情形断。凡是论文书、票据、契约，取父母爻为用爻：旺相就有成，落空就无用；财爻发动，或者世爻、身爻落空，就白费纸笔、枉费心思。
rule.en: In judging documents and tidings, take the document as the chief and Pressure as the ground. For official seals and documents it is fitting that Resource move; for bills and contracts drawn up by the people, avoid Wealth flourishing; if Wealth sits on the Body or the Self, the writing of the deed is in vain; if the Subject is not Void, hold to this situation. In judging documents, bills and contracts, take Resource as the Subject line: if thriving it succeeds, if Void it is useless; if the Wealth line moves, or the Self or Body is Void, the paper and brush are toiled for in vain and thought is wasted.

yi: 以文书为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the document as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 官印文书宜父动，民修票约忌财兴，
yi: 官府的印信文书，适宜父爻发动；民间立的票据契约，忌讳财爻兴旺；
财爻临在身爻、世爻上，书契就白写了。
用爻不落空亡，就按这个情形断。
en: For official seals and documents it is fitting that Resource move; for bills and contracts drawn up by the people, avoid Wealth flourishing;
if Wealth sits on the Body or the Self, the writing of the deed is in vain.
If the Subject is not Void, hold to this situation.

zh: 凡论文书票约，取父母为用爻，旺则有成，空则无用，财爻为动或值世身空，劳纸笔枉费神思。
yi: 凡是论文书、票据、契约，取父母爻为用爻：旺相就有成，落空就无用；财爻发动，或者世爻、身爻落空，就白费纸笔、枉费心思。
en: In judging documents, bills and contracts, take Resource as the Subject line: if thriving it succeeds, if Void it is useless; if the Wealth line moves, or the Self or Body is Void, the paper and brush are toiled for in vain and thought is wasted.

note.yi: 「票约」是票据和契约，「书契」是写下来的契约文书，「官印文书」是官府盖印的文书。「周不空亡准此情」的「周」疑是「用」（用神，这里是父母爻），译作「用爻不落空亡」。这一条与易隐文书占「文书占·公私之辨与成否」（YY.71）取同一个关系：都以父母为用，公家的文书看官旺，私下的契约看财怕克父。
note.en: 'Piaoyue' are bills and contracts, 'shuqi' are the written contract documents, and 'guanyin wenshu' are documents sealed by the authorities. The 'zhou' of 'zhou bu kongwang zhun ci qing' is presumably 'yong', the Subject (here the Resource line), and it is translated 'if the Subject is not Void'. This entry takes the same relation as 'public and private divinations and success' in the Yi Yin divination on documents (YY.71): both take Resource as the Subject, and for the document of the state one looks at the star of office thriving, for a private contract one fears Wealth controlling Resource.

units.title: 文书消息：鬼是元神空不就、财为忌客动难成，父之冲克真为假、母变生扶却信凭；卦无官鬼或落空亡皆主不就，妻爻发动契必难成，财动官亦动反能成契，父母若被日月冲破或化绝化空此契不能见信于人，父母若遇生扶或变为有气此书纵假而可为真

rule.yi: 官鬼是元神，落空就办不成；财是忌神，发动就难成；父爻被冲克，真的也成了假的；父母爻变出生扶它的爻，就有信凭。具体说：卦里没有官鬼，或者官鬼落空亡，都主办不成；妻爻发动，契约必定难成；财动官也动，反而能成契约；父母爻如果被日月冲破，或者化绝、化空，这份契约不能取信于人；父母爻如果遇到生扶，或者变成有气，这份文书即使是假的也可以当真。
rule.en: Pressure is the Support, and if Void it does not succeed; Wealth is the Adversary, and if it moves it is hard to accomplish; if Resource is clashed or controlled, the genuine turns false; if Resource changes and is generated and supported, it gains credence. In detail: if the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on Void, all mean it will not succeed; if the wife line, Wealth, moves, the contract will surely be hard to complete; if Wealth moves and the star of office also moves, on the contrary the contract can be completed; if Resource is clashed or broken by the Day or Month, or changes into extinction or Void, this contract cannot be believed by others; if Resource meets generation and support, or changes into something with qi, then even if this document is false it can be taken as true.

zh: 鬼是元神空不就，财为忌客动难成，
父之冲克真为假，母变生扶却信凭。
yi: 官鬼是元神，落空就办不成；财是忌神，发动就难成；
父爻被冲克，真的也成了假的；父母爻变出生扶它的爻，反而有信凭。
en: Pressure is the Support, and if Void it does not succeed; Wealth is the Adversary, and if it moves it is hard to accomplish;
if Resource is clashed or controlled, the genuine turns false; if Resource changes and is generated and supported, it gains credence.

zh: 卦无官鬼或落空亡，皆主不就。
父母若被日月冲破、或化绝化空，此契不能见信于人。
父母若遇生扶、或变为有气，此书纵假而可为真也。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼，或者官鬼落空亡，都主办不成。
妻爻（财爻）发动，契约必定难成。
财爻发动、官爻也发动，反而能成契约。
父母爻如果被日月冲破，或者化绝、化空，这份契约不能取信于人。
父母爻如果遇到生扶，或者变成有气，这份文书即使是假的也可以当作真的。
en: If the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on Void, all mean it will not succeed.
If the wife line, Wealth, moves, the contract will surely be hard to complete.
If Wealth moves and the star of office also moves, on the contrary the contract can be completed.
If Resource is clashed or broken by the Day or Month, or changes into extinction or Void, this contract cannot be believed by others.
If Resource meets generation and support, or changes into something with qi, then even if this document is false it can be taken as true.

note.yi: 「元神」是生用神的爻，「忌客」按文意是忌神（见术语表）：这里用神是父母（文书），官鬼生父母所以是元神，财克父母所以是忌神。「母」是父母爻。末两句「父之冲克真为假，母变生扶却信凭」「此书纵假而可为真」书里就是这样说的：文书取不取信于人，看父母爻的旺衰生克；这里照字面译，不替它加解释。
note.en: 'Yuanshen', the Support, is the line that generates the Subject, and 'jike', the Adversary guest, is by the sense the Adversary (see the glossary): here the Subject is Resource (the document), so Pressure, which generates Resource, is the Support, and Wealth, which controls Resource, is the Adversary. 'Mu', mother, is the Resource line. The last two statements, 'if Resource is clashed or controlled, the genuine turns false; if Resource changes and is generated and supported, it gains credence' and 'even if this document is false it can be taken as true', are exactly what the book says: whether a document is believed depends on the strength, generation and control of the Resource line; it is translated literally here, with no explanation added.
